violations.msg: C80 intersects ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 antenna keepout - no copper on ANY layer. Wi-Fi is a supported control path (H1-Q8), so this is functional, not cosmetic. Espressif HDG wants the antenna overhanging the edge or a 6 mm-deep relief with >=15 mm lateral clearance; the fixed 100x80 outline cannot overhang, so this band is the substitute. (1.92 mm2)
